title: How To Call A Menu On A Webpage
text:
## How To Call A Menu On A Webpage
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000034726
In this article, you will learn how to call a menu on a webpage or within a widget.
To do this, navigate to Toolbox >> Widget Manager , then click Copy Shortcode under Actions for the desired menu. In this example, the shortcode from the Side by Side Pricing Menu ( add-on ) is used.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180301065/original/ud64sVOkqyyubFICavJIdEd_2ol7X9f6Bg.png?1781230549 | alt: ]
After copying the shortcode, it can be used on any webpage or widget. For this example, the menu is added to a new webpage with the URL /pricing-test . Navigate to Content >> Web Page Builder and click New Web Page .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180301076/original/L3PeGxxtMPSC2ZXqz0LwkTX9iYbA117PLg.png?1781230603 | alt: ]
Paste the copied shortcode into the content area, assign a unique URL, and click Save Web Page .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180301095/original/Mfu43kwUYkOG5NFX5DQOlx5PFEy8tfuxuQ.png?1781230665 | alt: ]
The menu will render automatically on the new webpage.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180301126/original/19FcpcyzqIriSoZbWYwZqRCwYIXNoZfr-Q.png?1781230703 | alt: ]
The same approach can be used to display a menu inside a widget. Copy the shortcode for the desired menu and paste it into the HTML tab of a custom or default widget.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180301149/original/DP2klTxpuvuKa7p5_U4BzvkkfzkLnjCHoQ.png?1781230774 | alt: ]
